job_post_detail.title: Marketing Trainee（德语）-2027校招
job_post_detail.description:
1、Dive into customer trends, competitor offerings and target audience demographic.
2、Discover & leverage effective marketing and promotional channels, including KOL, PR, and other tactics, to convey product messages to customers effectively.
3、Create innovative marketing campaigns to approach customers.
job_post_detail.requirement:
1、Experience with integrated marketing campaigns.
2、Excellent communication and presentation skills.
3、Working knowledge of market research, surveys, and data analytics.
4、Experience in planning and leading initiatives.
5、Problem-solving skills.
6、Fluent in French/German/Spanish/Italian speaking and writing. Native speakers are preferred.
